entries.546b7a9b1722466b: It takes orders from connector manufacturers and other customers and performs press die design and manufacturing, precision press processing, precious metal surface treatment and insert molding in an integrated manner at its bases in Japan and the Philippines, earning revenue from sales of the processed parts.
entries.5a123deb78f5aeea: This is the process of applying high-speed gold plating, palladium-nickel alloy plating, tin plating and other treatments to press-formed contact components such as connectors, switches and IC sockets. Precision partial gold plating, which applies gold only to the required areas, is carried out using the reel-to-reel method. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.5a4a7ab48c837a9c: Its customers are mainly electronic component manufacturers such as connector manufacturers. The major customer disclosed is JAE Philippines Inc. (for the Philippines).
entries.640bfbf3bd3ace89: Its key strategies are to expand orders, centering on advanced product fields, and to pursue growth strategies and improve employee engagement. It states that it will continue capital investment in the automotive, telecommunications and industrial equipment fields, which it regards as future growth areas, and will work to strengthen its management base by securing a stable earnings base and developing new business areas.
entries.72532fbb8879fe9c: This is a business for the Southeast Asian region, carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Sanno Philippines Manufacturing Corporation (SPMC). It performs surface treatment, such as gold plating, on contact components such as connectors, switches and IC sockets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥4,062 million. Its base is the head plant in Cavite Province, Republic of the Philippines. JAE Philippines Inc. is disclosed as a major customer.
entries.78a3e21995256e9a: This is the process of manufacturing precision plastic components, centered on insert molding.

entries.b742ac75d7367278: Its features are its capability to perform precision press processing, precious metal surface treatment and insert molding in an integrated manner, and its ability to meet the quality, price and delivery requirements of its customers. entries.e3307a1b93c58a00: A company that handles, as an integrated process, precision press working and die manufacturing, surface treatment such as precious metal plating, and insert molding for electronic components such as connectors and switches.
entries.e5213062c076ea7b: This is the process of applying high-speed gold plating, palladium-nickel alloy plating, tin plating and others to press-formed products, using the reel-to-reel method. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.e923d4cb488dc2fb: This is the process of manufacturing precision plastic components, centered on insert molding. It handles everything in-house, from die design and manufacture through to molding production. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.efab02f4600774cd: This is the process in which, on commission from connector manufacturers and others, the company designs and manufactures connector press dies, and uses those dies to process press materials such as copper alloys to produce hoop-formed products. It can handle products with a material thickness of 0.05 mm and a pitch (pin spacing) of 0.25 mm. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.f1c2513bd44d315f: This is the business in Japan carried out by the company itself. For electronic components such as connectors and switches, the company designs and manufactures press dies, performs precision press processing, surface treatment such as precious metal plating, and insert molding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥11,468 million. In addition to its head office (Kohoku Ward, Yokohama City), its locations include the Tohoku Division (Koriyama City, Fukushima Prefecture), the Hadano Press Technology Center (Hadano City, Kanagawa Prefecture), the Suzukawa Technology Center (Isehara City, Kanagawa Prefecture) and the Furukawa Plant (Osaki City, Miyagi Prefecture).
